# KALAH (vs computer) - K. Semrad, DREAMER 6 p.9 (PDF p.11), with "Modification to KALAH"
# by R. Semrad, DREAMER 16 p.18 (PDF p.20), and its errata in DREAMER 17 (PDF p.48).
# CHIP-8 0200-03FF, run C000. Hole table moved to 0080-008D (score BCD at 00FC).
# At start press C = play against the computer (it plays B, the top/white holes), B = two players.
# keys 1-6 choose your hole (see kalah.txt).

#   02BA A07F, 0318 A080, 0322 A0FC, 0356 1386, 036E A07F; THEN ADD 0380-03FF.
# Errata (issue 17): 038B = 86 (printed A085 -> A086); 03CA = E0 (see note at 03C0).
